purpose: Hypothesis queue for the autonomous research loop. Each entry has a falsifiable gate, a kill condition set, an expected output path, and a status the loop maintains.
approach_change: Round 13 update: user redirected the loop from matrix-building (certifier routing, form atlases) to ingestion+synthesis. The new approach pulls fresh data (web search, articles, news, Reddit, HN) every tick, runs a brain trust of sub-agents (research ingestor, focus-group synthesizer, database updater) to extract pain signals and idea hypotheses, and updates docs/idea-database.json. Matrix-building entries from the prior approach are kept here as reference but not actively pursued unless the synthesis loop surfaces them.

convention.id: kebab-case identifier, unique across the queue
convention.priority: Lower number = run first. Resolved at tick start by picking the lowest-numbered pending entry.
convention.status: pending | in_progress | validated | killed | parked | needs_human
convention.result: Free text. For validated: a 1-2 line summary of what was learned. For killed: the kill reason. For parked: the next concrete step. For needs_human: which human action would unblock.
convention.sources_examined: List of {url, retrieval_date, source_type, claim} triples the tick collected.

entries.hypothesis: Each tick of the synthesis loop should: (1) ingest 5-10 fresh sources, (2) extract 2-5 new pain/workaround signals via focus-group simulation, (3) generate 1-3 idea hypotheses via mock-hackathon lens, (4) dedupe against the corpus, (5) persist surviving ideas to docs/idea-database.json as raw or validating records, (6) regenerate the catalog, (7) re-schedule.
entries.gate: Per-tick: at least 5 fresh sources, at least 1 new idea hypothesis that survives dedupe (no exact match in the existing 352-idea corpus), and at least 1 record added to the corpus OR a documented kill reason.
entries.output: Append to research/loop-log.jsonl; update docs/RESEARCH-MARATHON-2026-08-11-TRACKER.md; may add 1-3 new records to docs/idea-database.json.
kill_conditions: Three consecutive ticks produce no surviving new ideas (information-gain floor).
Token budget exhausted before the gate is reachable.
entries.resurrection_signal: User intervention or a new high-signal source category that the current search formula misses.
